concerns.text: FR-010 (clean finite‑time baseline for every window size T) is not covered by any task. The spec requires a baseline per window size, but the current tasks only compute a single asymptotic baseline (T009). Add a task (e.g., T017) that computes and stores a baseline FTLE for each window size T used in the analysis, with verification that the baseline JSON contains entries for all T values.

SC-004 (pipeline runtime ≤ 45 min) is not verified by any task. T014 only benchmarks the before/after optimization of two stages, but does not assert the total end‑to‑end runtime meets the 45‑minute CI limit. Add a task (e.g., T018) that runs the full pipeline on a representative configuration, records total wall‑clock time, and fails if it exceeds 45 minutes.
